# metamcp_mcp_server (Data Source)

Looks up an existing MCP server by name or UUID.

Credential fields (`env`, `headers`, `bearer_token`) are deliberately not exposed here: they belong in the resource, where Terraform tracks them as sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing server by name, or by UUID.
data "metamcp_mcp_server" "github" {
  name = "github"
}

# error_status reports the last connection error MetaMCP saw, if any: a quick
# way to check a server is reachable without opening the web UI.
output "github_status" {
  value = data.metamcp_mcp_server.github.error_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Server name. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.
- `uuid` (String) Server UUID. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `args` (List of String)
- `command` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `error_status` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)
